Feature.Description: Provides a self-contained HTML page for device-specific UI rendering. When this feature is present, clients may use the CustomUI property to display a tailored interface instead of the generic dynamic view.

Property.Description: A self-contained HTML page (with inline CSS and JavaScript) that renders a device-specific user interface. Intended to be displayed in a sandboxed iframe. Uses window.parent.postMessage() to request command execution and property reads from the host application.
